Name: Creatures of the Night
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Possums and foxes and wolves, oh my!

This mod came to me in a brainstorm. It combines open source assets from plurffle, vanilla, baristarulesgood, and some of my own to bring you a whopping [s]14[/s] 18! new animals for your farm! They are as follows:

Coop:

-Ravens: produce feathers and eggs that can be hatched and turned into mayo
-Bats: drop bug meat and bat wings
-Rats: dig up mixed seeds and fiber
-Owls: Barn, horned and snowy owls will all drop bone fragments and owl eggs that can be hatched in the ostrich incubator or turned into mayo
-Possums: dig up mixed seeds and truffles
-Ferret: drops bug meat and bug steaks
-Weasel: also drops bug meat and bug steaks
-Raccoons: drop trash and joja colas

Barn: 

-Wolves: Grey wolves will drop carp and catfish, Black wolves will drop largemouth bass and rainbow trout, and White wolves will drop salmon and ice pips
-Skunks: dig up spring onions and garlic
-Badgers: Dig up fiddlehead ferns and winter roots
-Foxes: Red foxed dig up blueberries and strawberries, Grey foxes dig up salmonberries and blackberries, Brown foxes dig up spice berries and blackberries, and Arctic foxes dig up hazelnuts and snow yams
-Coyotes: Coyotes will dig up common mushrooms and morels
-Black Cat: a barn cat that brings you sunfish and ghostfish
-Ghosts: drop ghost slime that can be put through the mayo machine for a jar of ectoplasm
-Spiders: there are two configurable options for spiders, cute or spooky. They can also be disabled completely for arachnophobia sufferers. They make spiderwebs that can be put through the loom to make a bolt of silk cloth


All animals can be toggled on and off as desired to include or exclude from your game. They can all be bought at Marnie's as usual.

[b][u]AS OF 1.1 SELPH'S EXTRA ANIMAL CONFIGS IS REQUIRED AS SOME ANIMALS HAVE BEEN MOVED TO DIFFERENT BUILDINGS. SELL OR MOVE ANY YOU BOUGHT IN 1.0 BEFORE UPDATING[/u][/b]

Enjoy!
